description:
Write, debug and learn Go on iPhone and iPad. GopherForge combines an on-device Go compiler, source editor, tests, an offline React study workflow and a practical learning library. Build, run, test, vet and format with bundled Go 1.27.1, even offline once compatible project sources are present.

CODE AND DEBUG ON DEVICE
• Edit multi-file Go projects, go.mod and web sources with highlighting and keyboard shortcuts.
• Tap a Go line number to set a breakpoint. Run executes normally without breakpoints and automatically starts source debugging when they exist.
• Continue, Step Into, Step Over, Step Out and Stop. Inspect project call stacks, source locations and bounded current-frame local values.
• Follow diagnostics to source; inspect test results, output, images and concurrency timelines.
• Import GitHub commit snapshots or Files content, export work, and organize projects with favorites, tags, search and a collapsible sidebar.

EXPLORE REACT OFFLINE
• Build browser JS, JSX, TypeScript, TSX, CSS and local JSON with bundled esbuild WASI.
• Build from Output with Build & Preview or the documented offline npm commands and fixed React catalog. Open full screen, reload and share the project archive.
• Trace small deterministic in-memory Go APIs through an explicit Gin-compatible adapter and local request replay. No network listener or cloud runtime is used.
• This educational mode has no full Node.js/npm runtime, Bun, arbitrary scripts, Vite plugins or registry downloads. TypeScript is transpiled without type checking. API state is temporary.

LEARN GO AND PREPARE FOR INTERVIEWS
• Follow 220 teaching lessons and 22 prediction challenges across 28 units, including 173 worked readings with code, diagrams, references and understanding checks.
• Study values, collections, interfaces, errors, generics, modules, concurrency, runtime and the standard library.
• Explore four architecture/clean-code units with 40 lessons, all 23 classic patterns and six Go concurrency/resilience patterns.
• Study production transactions, outbox/inbox, sagas, API evolution, tenant isolation, observability, gRPC, Protobuf and Kafka.
• New Around Go units cover Gin, blockchain infrastructure and service security: SDK roles, exact amounts, nonces, reorg-safe indexing, authorization, TLS and input ownership.
• Work through JSON v2 contracts, SQL service lifetimes, WaitGroup.Go, synctest and errgroup.
• Learn Bash, Git, Docker, Kubernetes, MongoDB, Redis and workflows with Codex, Claude Code and Cursor in your native environment.
• Prepare with 132 interview guides, 15 topics, four levels and twelve interactive algorithm labs with 36 scenarios.
• Return with Continue and restored lesson drafts. Course completion, compiler evidence, interview marks, assistance and study places persist locally. Review matches concepts; Fix mistakes explains three-choice answers.

MADE FOR YOUR DEVICE
Native layouts adapt to iPhone, iPad and supported Duo postures. Use touch or external keyboards, themes, text size, extra scroll room and supported Face ID/passcode locking. One paid download, no subscription, advertising trackers or app account. Projects and progress stay local; a chosen Files/iCloud library follows your provider. App and web progress are separate.

COMPATIBILITY
Go runs in WebAssembly/WASI with bounded memory/output: no guest networking, cgo or general shell. Ordinary Run has no guaranteed CPU Stop. Module ZIP budgets include 4,000 files. Imports and missing Go packages need a connection. Source debugging covers project code, without watches or conditional breakpoints. Stop needs a project checkpoint. Isolated frontend previews block external requests; legacy local HTML previews may load project-linked resources. Database, deployment and agent lessons teach external native workflows.

reviewNotes:
GopherForge 1.3.1 build 49. Educational Go programming environment. No account or demo credentials required. Release automatically after approval. This build includes the workbench/source-safety changes from the superseded 1.3.0 build 48 plus the expanded curriculum.

NEW LEARNING: Learn > Course has 28 units / 220 teaching lessons, 173 readings and 22 separate prediction challenges. Scroll to Architecture: consistency and evolution (9), Clean code: production contracts (4), Around Go: Gin services (6), Around Go: blockchain infrastructure (7), and Around Go: service security (4). Concurrency and the standard library also have new readings. Each has code, explanations, visual steps, references and an understanding check. Native SDK/RPC/database/security/deployment examples are learning material for a separate native environment. They do not add networking, a wallet, node, key custody or other services to the app.

INTERVIEW: Learn > Interview has 132 guides / 15 topics / four levels. Open Gin services, Blockchain infrastructure or Go service security, reveal an answer and mark Understood/Revisit. The 12 interactive algorithm labs retain 36 scenarios. Four additional algorithm guides are worked explanations, not additional interactive labs.

PERSISTENCE: Open a reading, mark complete, relaunch and use Continue. Existing lesson IDs and storage formats are retained. Edited exercise drafts and pre-solution source restore across navigation/relaunch. Self-reported reading completion differs from compiler evidence; interview marks are independent. Projects/progress remain local subject to the selected Files/iCloud provider. No sign-in, subscription, IAP, ads or analytics SDK.

SOURCE DEBUGGER: Projects > Examples > Source debugger > Source debugger walkthrough > Open. Set a gutter breakpoint on line 12, then Run. Step Into enters double. Step Over/Out and Continue inspect project frames and locals. Remove breakpoints for ordinary Run. Stop needs the next own-source checkpoint. No watches, conditional breakpoints or vendor/stdlib stepping.

OFFLINE REACT: Projects > Examples > Offline frontend > React + Gin study board > Open. Run checks Go routes; Output > Build & Preview builds React from bundled sources. Alternatively use Terminal: npm install --offline, then npm run build. Open full screen, add a task, change a filter and reload. Share project exports source, not a public URL. Legacy static previews additionally offer a device-only loopback browser address.

Supported npm commands invoke a bounded educational builder, not Node/npm, Bun or a general shell. esbuild WASI and fixed React sources are bundled. No registry downloads, arbitrary scripts, hooks or plugins. TypeScript is transpiled without checking. Isolated previews block external network requests. Explicit gin-replay paths use bounded local httptest reconstruction, not sockets or a remote server. Project sources remain viewable/editable.

Bundled Go 1.27.1 runs in bounded WASI: no guest networking or cgo. Ordinary Run has no guaranteed CPU deadline/tight-loop Stop; memory/output/module budgets remain. Learning expansion passed 43 focused native checks, with saved drafts, Continue and independent interview marks. A separate QA build previously verified physical local Files-library switching; remote iCloud sync is not certified. Complete instructions and limits: https://gopherforge.app/guide
